Application.Text1:
protocols:
protocol_id: P01
stage: 固定与预聚合物浸润
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: 冰冷预聚合物：4% PFA、4% acrylamide、0.05% bis-acrylamide、0.25% VA-044，PBS；4 °C
duration_original: 72 h
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:B051;S2:p8;S2:Fig1A
boundary: 百分比基准未逐项说明；不包括临床取得与组织取出操作。

Application.Text2:
protocols:
protocol_id: P02
stage: 脱气及充氮
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: 真空室脱气后充纯氮，以置换氧
duration_original: 10 min degassing; nitrogen filling duration not reported
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:B051;S2:p8
boundary: 10 min是脱气时长；不能当作整个聚合时间。

Application.Text3:
protocols:
protocol_id: P03
stage: 热聚合
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: 37 °C；预聚合物与组织在上述腔室中；随后去除多余外表凝胶
duration_original: 3 h
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:B051;S2:p8;S2:Fig1B
boundary: Fig1B写under vacuum，正文写脱气后充氮；最终压力与气氛细节未报。

Application.Text4:
protocols:
protocol_id: P04
stage: 被动脱脂清透
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: 200 mM boric acid、4% (w/v) SDS、去离子水、NaOH调pH 8.5；37 °C；48 h换首次清液，此后每周更换
duration_original: Methods and Fig1C: 8 weeks; Results: 6–8 weeks
time_role: clearing_stage_duration
source_locator: S1:B019/B052;S2:p2/p8;S2:Fig1C
boundary: 终点为近光学透明/半透明。首次48 h是阶段内换液点，不另加2天；8周不等于全流程或保存窗。

Application.Text5:
protocols:
protocol_id: P05
stage: 清透后/染色前PBST洗
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: 1×PBS、0.1% Triton X-100
duration_original: 24 h
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:B052/B054;S2:p8
boundary: 两个相邻小节各写一次24 h；可能重复叙述，也可能两次洗，不能擅自相加。

Application.Text6:
protocols:
protocol_id: P06
stage: 一抗孵育第一段
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: CD31血管标记及PGP9.5神经标记的一抗孵育，PBST；37 °C；PGP9.5试剂为M02或M03，详见M01–M03；是否同一混合液共孵育未明确。
duration_original: 48 h
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:B054;S2:p8
boundary: CD31 1:100；PGP9.5一抗稀释比未报，不从二抗稀释比反推。

Application.Text7:
protocols:
protocol_id: P07
stage: 一抗补充及第二段
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: 48 h时补充各一抗；37 °C
duration_original: additional 48 h
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:B054;S2:p8
boundary: 与P06合计96 h是一抗接触时间；作者为改善全组织分布，但未给渗透深度曲线。

Application.Text8:
protocols:
protocol_id: P08
stage: 一抗后洗
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: PBST；37 °C
duration_original: 24 h
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:B054;S2:p8
boundary: 不属于一抗或二抗接触时间。

Application.Text9:
protocols:
protocol_id: P09
stage: 二抗孵育
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: Alexa Fluor 568 donkey anti-mouse IgG与Alexa Fluor 488 goat anti-rabbit IgG；文末稀释1:100；37 °C；48 h时补充
duration_original: 96 h
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:B054;S2:p8
boundary: 48 h补充不是额外96 h；Fig1D染色8 d仅对应两轮抗体各4 d，未涵盖洗涤。

Application.Text10:
protocols:
protocol_id: P10
stage: 二抗后洗
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: PBST rinses
duration_original: not reported
time_role: stage_duration
source_locator: S1:B055;S2:p8
boundary: 次数、每次时长与温度未给定。

Application.Text11:
protocols:
protocol_id: P11
stage: 首次折射率匹配
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: 85% glycerol；25 °C；原文RI=1.45
duration_original: 24 h
time_role: refractive_index_matching_duration
source_locator: S1:B055;S2:p8
boundary: 这是染色后的匹配阶段。85%基准未报；末匹配同浓度甘油另印RI=1.35。

Application.Text12:
protocols:
protocol_id: P12
stage: 琼脂糖包埋成塞
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: 1%低熔点agarose，A4018 Sigma-Aldrich；在1 cc注射器内形成锥形塞
duration_original: not reported; Fig1E mounting = 1 day
time_role: mounting_duration
source_locator: S1:B055;S2:p8;S2:Fig1E
boundary: 图示1 d可能概括匹配/安装，不能另当精确凝固时长或与P11无条件相加。

Application.Text13:
protocols:
protocol_id: P13
stage: 终末介质匹配与成像浸没
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: 85% glycerol，原印RI=1.35；或PROTOS，原印RI=1.46，23.5% (w/v) n-methil-d-glucamine、29.4% (w/v) diatrizoic acid、32.4% (w/v) iodixanot
duration_original: not reported
time_role: refractive_index_matching_duration
source_locator: S1:B055;S2:p8
boundary: 保留作者拼写与RI冲突；PROTOS溶剂、配制细节和逐样本介质分配未报，未调用参考文献49补齐。

Application.Text14:
protocols:
protocol_id: P14
stage: 整髓光片采集
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: Zeiss Lightsheet Z.1；单侧或双侧照明依样本尺寸；详情I01–I03
duration_original: not reported
time_role: acquisition_time
source_locator: S1:B057/B058;S2:p8
boundary: 不能从影片播放秒数推算采集时间。

Application.Text15:
protocols:
protocol_id: P15
stage: 局部共聚焦采集
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: Zeiss LSM 880；20×/0.8 Plan-Apochromat M-27；Fig4和FigS2B,C
duration_original: not reported
time_role: acquisition_time
source_locator: S1:B057;S2:p8;S2:Fig4;S3:FigS2
boundary: 局部共聚焦演示，不扩展为全部整髓图均20×采集。

Application.Text16:
protocols:
protocol_id: P16
stage: 拼接、三维显示与追踪
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: Imaris Stitcher原印9.2.0 (v9.1)，或Arivis Vision 4D格式；重叠10%–15%；Imaris Filament手工XYZ追踪所选神经束
duration_original: not reported
time_role: analysis_time
source_locator: S1:B058/B059;S2:p8;S3:FigS4
boundary: 自动Filament追踪被跳过；软件版本原文不一致；不是每条神经的自动完整重建。

Application.Text17:
protocols:
protocol_id: P17
stage: 横断面与直径分析
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: Imaris ortho slicer选10 µm ROI，绝对强度阈值/表面模块；再用1 µm切片与统计着色输出µm²；直径由slice view测量
duration_original: not reported
time_role: analysis_time
source_locator: S1:B038/B060;S2:p5/p8;S2:Fig5A–K
boundary: 10 µm和1 µm是分析切片厚度，不是实测成像深度、组织厚度或轴向分辨率；阈值、分母和ROI分配缺项。

Application.Text18:
protocols:
protocol_id: P18
stage: 展示图背景处理
sample_scope: SAMPLE01；通用固定牙髓方案，无逐牙条件表
conditions: Imaris裁剪并导出分通道TIFF序列；ImageJ BaSiC默认flatfield/darkfield估计后重新导入；使用原文件voxel settings
duration_original: not reported
time_role: analysis_time
source_locator: S1:B061;S2:p8
boundary: 作者称仅部分展示图，引用Fig1A与FigS1；Fig1A是示意图，定位有疑点；不能推定所有定量数据均做此处理。
